headline: GSK Beats Third-Quarter Profit Forecasts and Reaffirms Annual Guidance
summary: GSK reported third-quarter profits ahead of analyst consensus estimates and reaffirmed its full-year earnings guidance, although its shares saw mild downward pressure following the release.
why: GSK is a major British pharmaceutical and vaccine developer with significant weighting on the FTSE 100 index.

impacts.name: GSK plc
impacts.why: GSK shares dipped slightly post-announcement despite meeting and exceeding profit expectations.
